verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
All creation cries to you
Worshipping in Spirit and in truth

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines: Glory to the faithful one Jesus Christ God's son

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
All Creation gives you praise
You alone are truly great

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: You alone are God who reigns for eternity

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
God is great and his praise
fills the earth fills the heavens and
your name will be praise through all the world

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
God is great sing his praise
all the earth all the heavens

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
cause were living for the Glory of your name
The Glory of your name

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
All to you Oh God we bring
Jesus teach us how to live

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Let your fire burn in us
that all may hear and all may see

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines:
Bridge:
Holy is the Lord
The whole earth sings
The whole earth sings
